note: RV park 5 minutes southwest of Bonnyville near Highway 28 and the Bonnyville Golf Club, selling long-term and short-term lots for work and leisure stays, with weekly and monthly rates beside the daily one; off-leash dog park, firewood, a backup generator, snow removal and mail forwarding. RVs must be 20 years old or newer; units over 15 years need management approval. --Claude
summary: Operator's site and Campspot read. Confirmed C$45-60 daily (Standard to Platinum) plus a C$4 park booking fee, 50/30-amp full hookups, 60-ft lots, open year-round, showers, laundry, phone. Long-stay tests pass: one night is sold online with no minimum, and 20 sites were open for single weeknights in November 2026. Google 4.9 (53 reviews).
